description:
Uplifting Music | Dilruba for Morning Energy | 1.5 Hours

If your morning needs lift instead of grind — start here. 1.5 hours of slow dilruba for fresh morning energy and easy focus.

The dilruba is a bowed Indian instrument with a deep, breath-like sound — gentle enough for early morning, structured enough to pull your attention into shape.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Dilruba — bowed Indian classical instrument with warm vocal-like tone
- Long flowing phrases with natural breathing pauses
- A gentle 8Hz Alpha wave layer associated with calm focused alertness
- Unbroken 1.5 hours — no abrupt fades, no startling moments

⏱ Chapters
0:00   Waking — gentle entry
12:00  Mind softening into focus
35:00  Clear-headed work zone
65:00  Sustained morning calm
80:00  Gentle close

🧠 How to use:
Press play with your morning coffee or first task. Don't try to force focus — let the strings do it. Headphones recommended for the Alpha wave layer.

⏱ Best for:
• Morning work sessions
• Pre-meeting mental warm-up
• Study mornings
• Slow-start mornings (anxious wake-ups)
• Daily focus reset

📺 Subscribe to Raga Focus for daily uploads:
- Sitar, Sarangi, Veena, Surbahar, Bansuri, Tanpura, Dilruba and other Indian instruments
- Music for anxiety, overthinking, sleep, stress, emotional release

— Raga Focus
